EMUDHRA.text: eMudhra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 21, 2026, titled "eMudhra Statement on distrust of select Global TLS Intermediate and one Root CA".
EMUDHRA.hint: Pehle padh lo: asar kya hoga ye text/PDF se samajhna padega.
EMUDHRA.summary: What happened The matter concerns 8 of eMudhra’s several intermediate CAs that were trusted as part of its Global TLS business. These issuing CAs were created under eMudhra’s ECC root in a Key Generation Ceremony (KGC) held on April 30, 2025, using FIPS 140-2 Level 3 Hardware Security Modules (HSMs). Limited commercial impact The affected global TLS business is a very small part of eMudhra’s operations and accounts for around 1% of the company’s revenue. | Mukhya: rs,, 1%
